report: Reviewed the complete terminal_incompleteness claim, its sole implementation TODO and sole associated TODO test in service_spec.rs, plus captured review rules, architectural-foundations rationale and the module-completeness interface excerpt. The claim requires (1) a terminal semantic phase outcome, (2) a distinction between complete and conservative limited results, (3) coverage of user errors, unsupported functionality, unavailable facts and explicit resource bounds, and (4) no representation of those terminal limitations as pending scheduling. The linked rationale explains retaining useful conservative facts and allowing recomputation only when inputs or limits change. All four obligations remain explicitly deferred by the pipeline-wide implementation TODO: module expansion does not yet publish a uniform terminal completeness result. The captured module source has consumer-specific boolean method-provider and symbol-listing completeness interfaces, with error/unexpanded-attribute/derive checks, rather than the uniform reason-bearing phase outcome needed to establish the full claim. This is supporting context for the stated deferral, not an approval of those helpers or an assertion that no partial completeness behavior exists. No ordinary implementation entry claims pipeline-wide completion. The complete associated test body, todo::crates_sage_ir_crate_terminal_incompleteness, contains only a TODO and no assertions; it is not behavioral evidence. Its deferred scenarios require each phase to expose its incomplete reason and surviving guarantees, then repeat demand without input/limit changes and assert it cannot become complete. The prerequisite is the uniform terminal phase-result contract identified by the implementation TODO, followed by fixtures covering each of the four limitation causes and repeated-demand behavior. That explicit prerequisite and deferred test plan adequately explain the absent end-to-end coverage. No N/A entries exist. Accepted only as honest deferred implementation and test evidence; no capability is relabeled implemented. Source inspection and review start/read were performed; no behavioral tests were run, since the associated test is a no-op TODO and running it would not establish this claim. No source files were changed.
